name: Corporate Action Event Type 111 Choice
definition: Choice between formats to express the corporate event type.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Event types expressed as a code.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Event types expressed as a proprietary code.

EventTypeRule.definition: If Code is present, the code OTHR must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate. ||If Code is present, the code CHAN must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. ||If Code is present, the code REDM must only be used when the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.
